name: fuzzphony/fuzzphony
description: Fuzzy search, in perfect harmony with your database. PostgreSQL-native full-text + trigram search for PHP and Symfony, without an extra service.

suggest.doctrine/dbal: Use an existing Doctrine DBAL connection (Fuzzphony\Bridge\Doctrine\DbalConnection)
suggest.doctrine/migrations: Run the migration fuzzphony:schema --dump-migration writes (the bundle hides Fuzzphony's tables from migrations:diff)
suggest.doctrine/orm: Load results as entities (EntityLoader) and sync in ORM mode (OrmSyncListener)
suggest.symfony/framework-bundle: Symfony integration: configuration, autowiring and the fuzzphony:* console commands
suggest.symfony/messenger: Asynchronous refresh in ORM sync mode (fuzzphony.orm_sync.async)
suggest.symfony/security-bundle: fuzzphony.actor.tenant / .user: the actor from the Security user
suggest.symfony/property-access: fuzzphony.actor.tenant / .user: property paths on the Security user
suggest.symfony/rate-limiter: fuzzphony.rate_limit: limit how often a tenant or user may search (a framework.rate_limiter entry)
suggest.symfony/security-core: fuzzphony.authorization: grant an index or a field to a user (the security.authorization_checker service comes from symfony/security-bundle)
suggest.promphp/prometheus_client_php: Export metrics in Prometheus's data model (Fuzzphony\Bundle\Observability\PrometheusMetricsCollector)
